messages:
Marta: Heads-up 50min sync 55 - I'm drafting a 1-pager for field that maps deploy modes -> security + SLA quick talking points. Need micro-copy + routing guidance by EOD so design can mock.
Sam: Nice. Sales wants a single-line hero stat comparing SLA predictability vs generic cloud endpoints. Keep it punchy for execs.
Marta: Draft hero: "99.95% SLA for Dedicated; predictable p99 latency across enterprise workloads." Need a bench line from infra to back it.
Alex: I can give a short bench note. Measured on our Dedicated pool for chat-ish loads (seq=1024): median ~120ms, p95 ~260ms. Pasteable: ```Bench (internal): Dedicated baseline (n1-highgpu) - median 120ms, p95 260ms for seq=1024 chat; fallback to hosted variants +30-50ms.```
Marta: Sweet. Field also wants a concise "which deployment" mapping they can read in 3s. Proposed bullets:
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, usage pricing, great for trials/proofs.
- Dedicated: reserved GPUs, SLA + throughput guarantees, recommended for steady high-volume production.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full data residency, KMS/HSM, audit logs for regulated customers.
Neil: Add a tiny inbound-routing recommendation piece: when to route to Dedicated vs Hosted dynamically.
Marta: Proposed routing one-liner + tiny snippet: "Route by customer tier + latency budget: premium -> Dedicated; else -> Hosted with cache"
Marta: ```routing: if customer.tier == \"enterprise\" and request.latency_budget_ms <= 300 -> route(Dedicated) else -> route(Hosted, prefix-cache)```
Clara: Marketing ask: give 2 subject lines for a field email and 2 CTAs to A/B test. Also short alt copy for preview text.
Marta: Options:
1) "SLA-backed inference: pick the right deployment for your team" (preview: "Dedicated SLAs, Private controls, and routing best practices")
2) "Stop guessing on latency: Dedicated SLAs & Private options" (preview: "Book a latency session or grab the checklist")
CTAs: A) Book a latency testing session; B) Download the one-pager + quick checklist.
Sam: Good. Prefer subject #2 for higher open with dev/platform buyers.
Alex: Also include graceful-degradation note: automatic fallback to quantized hosted variants and partial-response behaviour under capacity pressure. Short sentence ok.
Neil: Compliance blurb: "Supports SOC2. Private deployments enable HIPAA-ready controls with customer-managed KMS/HSM and audit logging." Good to go.
Marta: Design layout notes for Figma: single-page PDF, left column = hero stat + routing cheat sheet; right column = bullets (security, SLAs, cost levers, next steps). Small 3-step flow diagram for routing. Keep it printer-friendly.
Sam: Timeline: design mock by tomorrow 11:30, copywrap + legal + eng approval by Friday EOD. Can we hit that?
Marta: I'll finish copy this afternoon. Alex - can you convert the bench line into a short footnote we can quote verbatim? Clara - pick the subject line and CTA order for A/B and drop into the brief.
Alex: Footnote ready: "Benchmark measured on Dedicated baseline hardware; median 120ms and p95 260ms for seq=1024 chat. Results vary by model and sequence length." OK to quote.
Clara: I'll run subject #2 + CTA order: Book session first, Download second. Will upload the Figma brief and tag @Marta by 10:45.
launch-bot: Reminder: attach final one-pager to #field-assets and mark for sales-enablement pack.
Marta: Thanks. I'll fold in the bench footnote, routing snippet, compliance blurb, and upload first draft PDF by 11:00 for a quick review. :raised_hands:
